from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u031/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-4ccac9ba.py'
program_source = '''def transform(grid):
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for row in result:
        marked = [i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0]
        if len(marked) >= 2:
            for i in range(marked[0] + 1, marked[-1]):
                if row[i] == 0:
                    row[i] = 2
    return result
'''

exec(compile(program_source, str(program_path), 'exec'), ns)
